name: fix-critical-errors
details:
Fix the 3 critical error handling issues found during PR review:
1. Silent directory tree failures in buildDirectoryTree()
2. Misleading "Path not found" errors in exists() helper
3. Missing error handling tests

Using test-first approach with MCP-Debug integration testing.

tasks.name: Write error handling tests
tasks.details:
Add tests that currently fail, exposing the bugs:
- Test permission errors in buildDirectoryTree()
- Test exists() distinguishes ENOENT from EACCES
- Test per-file stat errors in viewDirectory()

sub_tasks.name: Test buildDirectoryTree permission errors
sub_tasks.details: Write test that creates directory with restricted permissions and verifies error is logged, not silent empty array

sub_tasks.name: Test exists() distinguishes errors
sub_tasks.details: Write test that verifies exists() throws for EACCES but returns false for ENOENT

sub_tasks.name: Test viewDirectory per-file errors
sub_tasks.details: Write test for race condition where file is deleted between readdir and stat

tasks.name: Fix exists() helper
tasks.details: Modify exists() to only return false for ENOENT, throw for other errors like EACCES

tasks.name: Fix buildDirectoryTree() catch block
tasks.details: Replace empty catch with error logging that distinguishes EACCES, ENOENT, and other errors

tasks.name: Fix viewDirectory() per-file handling
tasks.details: Add try-catch around fs.stat() loop to handle per-file errors gracefully

tasks.name: Run test suite
tasks.details: Verify all tests pass including new error handling tests

tasks.name: MCP-Debug integration test
tasks.details: Test the server with MCP-Debug to verify error handling works in real MCP context

tasks.name: Commit fixes
tasks.details: Create clean commit with error handling fixes and tests
